**D2 PR2 judgment R1 fixes — remove hardenDiffRendering, pins are determinism not content**

What: Judgment-day Round 1 found 5 confirmed issues (both judges forged) in the D2 PR2 predicate. Owner ruled both forks; fixes applied.

FORK A: REMOVE hardenDiffRendering (the `.git/info/attributes = "* diff"` write). Predicate is now PURE-READ. Reasons (all forged by both judges): (1) INERT in a linked worktree — writes to `git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir` but git reads info/attributes from `--git-common-dir`; brain mandates worktree-per-task; (2) DESTRUCTIVE — clobbers human `.git/info/attributes` (git-crypt), never restored; (3) REDUNDANT — `--binary` alone defeats the F-4 `-diff` attack (base85 carries content).

FORK B: KEEP the config pins (`-c diff.algorithm=myers -c diff.renames=false -c core.attributesFile=/dev/null --no-textconv --no-ext-diff`) but tell the truth about them. Forged the hostile-env harness (GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL adverse, GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null — the CP-PR1/B6 harness): forge_forkb2/forge_forkb3 show that GIVEN --binary, dropping any of these four does NOT flip a verdict (--binary bypasses textconv/ext-diff/attrs drivers; diff.algorithm is run-consistent). So they are DETERMINISM / defense-in-depth, labelled "NOT behaviorally tested", NEVER "reddens-on-drop". --binary is the real content+determinism guarantee.

Why: judges proved the F-4 hardening layer was over-claimed (false mutation-bar claims in header + §7.1 T9), ineffective in the mandated worktree topology, and destructive. Core inversion predicate itself is sound and fail-closed.

Where: brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/resolution.mjs + .test.mjs (delegated); openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/design.md §3.2/§7.1 (T9 rewritten, T12 hostile-env robustness + T13 J-2 added); forge evidence committed to openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/forge/.

Learned: patch-id ignores indentation whitespace (killed it earlier). `--binary` bypasses in-repo diff drivers → the env pins can't flip a verdict given --binary → honest label is "not behaviorally tested", not a fake reddens-on-drop test. J-2: `--first-parent --merges` enumeration means squash/rebase/direct-push reverts fall to human gate (fail-closed liveness gap; brain uses --merge so seen). Next: re-judge Round 2 after code agent completes.
